body.name: the positive-density confidence-modulus handle
body.construction: Derive the replacement-private modulus for honest pointwise CATE intervals by combining a coverage-to-testing reduction on ordinary positive-density Hölder bump submodels with a propose-test-release or disjoint-pair-block stabilization of the localized quadratic score, treating the global-sensitivity term of \(\mathsf M_{h,k,J_\pi,J_\mu}^{\mathrm{DP}}\) as the benchmark to improve or certify.
